title: LAN cache
intro: What the LAN cache saved, whether the cache machine is healthy, and what the hall downloads. Hall-wide numbers only.
pluginOff: The LAN cache plugin is off. Turn it on and tell the agent where the logs are.
pluginMissing: The LAN cache plugin is not installed. Install it from the Marketplace, turn it on and tell the agent where the logs are.
savedSub: served from the cache, not the internet
chartLabel: {{hit}} from the cache, {{miss}} from the internet
noAgent: No agent has reported on the cache yet. The LAN cache plugin runs on the local agent.
dnsOk: lancache-dns sends the cached services to the cache.
noDnsCheck: Set the DNS server and the cache host to check it.
clearQuestion: Empty the cache folder? Players download everything from the internet again until it fills up.
clearing_one: Clearing the cache: {{count}} file removed so far.
clearing_other: Clearing the cache: {{count}} files removed so far.
noDownloads_other: Nothing downloaded by {{count}} players or more yet.
downloadsText_one: A download is named once {{count}} player fetched it.
downloadsText_other: A download is named once {{count}} players fetched it.
otherDownloads: {{items}} other downloads ({{size}}) are counted but not named.
suspectsText: Files fetched from the internet three times or more in one hour: the cache is not keeping them (full disk, wrong slice size or a service that changes its files).
lookupsText: Lookups lancache-dns answered for the cached services.
